entities.name: Mindrel
entities.description: Character who tries to dissuade Brand from dark magic and fears she must defend her outer ring.

entities.name: Brand
entities.description: Character who dismisses Mindrel's advice and learns dark magic; his refuge is found corrupted.

events.summary: Mindrel tries to talk Brand out of learning dark magic; Brand dismisses her advice.
events.quote: Brand hears her but dismisses her advice

events.summary: Mindrel finds Brand's home refuge corrupted and lifeless and realizes she too must defend her outer ring.
events.quote: only to find his home refuge corrupted and lifeless
